g.text: Dynamic View: Android MCP bridge - Android bridge APK
[MCP2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP over authenticated loopback TCP/owner adb forward]
3: Plan exact binding, arguments and backend scope
4: Check per-client grant, Ask consent, OS/backend authority and current epochs
5: Pin compatible binding and coherent types
6: Recheck current document and contract pins
7: Return exact Admission and policy/contract pins
8: Dispatch Admission once; no replay of uncertain effects
10: Record admitted dispatch and observed/unknown outcome
11: Return bounded invocation result or structured denial/unknown outcome
12: Return single final JSON-RPC result/error; POST SSE normally terminates
